body.name: Observed matched slices and cycle product
body.construction: For each \(d\) and \(x,y\in\mathcal A\), tabulate \(A_{xy}^d[u,v]=P(X_0=u,X_1=x,X_2=y,X_3=v\mid D=d)\), retain \(\bar A_{xy}^d=A_{xy}^d[:,\mathcal A]\), tabulate \(m_x^d[u]=P(X_0=u,X_1=x\mid D=d)\), and set \(K^d=\bar A_{aa}^d(\bar A_{ba}^d)^{-1}\bar A_{bb}^d(\bar A_{ab}^d)^{-1}\).
